$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema reference for editor tooling.

start.description: Scene id where the game begins. Must exist as a key under `scenes`.

scenes.description: Scene graph keyed by scene id.

tiers.description: Score-to-label mapping. Resolver picks the highest qualifying entry. Optional.

intro.description: Lines printed once at the top of every start(). Optional.

items.description: Item catalogue keyed by item id. Referenced from Scene.items, Choice.requires/consumes/grants, and the runtime inventory.

initialState.description: Starting values for tracked state variables, seeded into the run on each start(). Choice/item effects mutate it; branches read it.

heading.description: Scene heading. Rendered in primary colour.

narration.description: Body lines. Each entry is one logger.log call.

choices.description: Numbered options the player picks via choose(n).

items.description: Items present in this scene at the start of a run. Player can pickup(n).

label.description: Display text shown after the choice index.

points.description: Score awarded for picking this choice. Optional.

flavour.description: Result callout printed after the choice. Optional.

next.description: Next scene id, or null to end the game.

requires.description: Item ids the player must hold for this choice to appear.

consumes.description: Item ids removed from inventory when this choice is picked.

grants.description: Item ids added to inventory when this choice is picked.

effects.description: State mutations applied when this choice is picked.

branches.description: Conditional transitions. First branch whose conditions all hold wins; falls back to next.

stateEffect.description: A mutation to a state variable.

condition.description: A predicate over run state. Discriminated by `kind`.

negate.description: For kind=hasItem / visited — invert the test.

choiceBranch.description: A guarded transition. All `when` conditions ANDed.

goTo.description: Destination when this branch wins; null finishes.

name.description: Player-facing display name for the item.

description.description: Optional longer description shown by inventory().

itemUseEffect.description: What happens when the player runs use(n) on this item.

inScenes.description: Scenes where the item can be used. Omit for anywhere.

text.description: Flavour text printed when the item is used.

goTo.description: Scene jump on use; null to finish the game; omit to stay.

consumed.description: If true, the item is removed from inventory after use.

effects.description: State mutations applied when the item is used.

color.description: Theme colour slot used to tint the tier label.

text.description: Template for the share post body. Placeholders: ${score}, ${max}, ${tier}.

url.description: Template for the share URL. Placeholders: ${score}, ${tier}.

intent.description: Share-platform preset. Defaults to x (Twitter). Use mastodon:host.tld to target a specific Mastodon instance.
